query: INSERT INTO audit_log(id,  timestamp, ip, location, user_agent, country, region, city, timezone,  actor_client_id, action, workspace_id, resource_id) VALUES (GENERATE_AUDIT_LOG_ID(),  NOW(), $1, ST_SetSRID(POINT($2, $3)::GEOMETRY, 4326), $4, $5, $6, $7, $8,  $9, $10, (SELECT workspace_id FROM resource WHERE id = $11), $11);
